summary: Pins the 'old embedder daemon keeps serving after an update' fix (hooks/embed-client.mjs replaceIfOlder) with a FAKE daemon on a scratch COLDSTART_HOME socket and no model: a fake answering with the same or a newer protocol must never get 'stop' and no spawn.lock may appear; a protocol-1 fake (protocol only on ping) answering an embed must have its answer used AND receive 'stop' from the real daemon the client spawned (its listen()). ORDER MATTERS: replaceIfOlder fires once per process, so the no-replace cases run first; the spawned daemon then fails its model download (COLDSTART_MODEL_URL dead) and afterAll SIGKILLs it via daemon.json. COLDSTART_EMBEDDER must be '1' in-test because vitest sets 0 (embedderOff blocks the replacement). Fails on HEAD's client before the fix, passes after.
